description: A high school principal must approve the operating plan for an evening student theater showcase, including the venue, lighting setup, audience capacity, and egress layout, with input from the theater teacher and facilities coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The school plans to hold an evening student theater showcase for families next month.
shared_context.S2: The auditorium is the usual venue for major student performances and is listed with a 300-person capacity; the gym is available as an alternate event space.
shared_context.S3: The principal must approve the final event operating plan before tickets are released.
shared_context.S4: The school's routine pre-event review includes a check-in with the theater teacher and facilities coordinator before the principal signs the plan.

PF1.text: The showcase's planned production uses the auditorium's fixed fly system and requires exactly four lighting circuits; the gym cannot support that staging configuration. Ms. Rivera completed the stage plan this week, but it is still attached to her production binder rather than the principal's approval packet.

PF2.text: The current fire-safety certificate limits this event to exactly 180 audience members and requires exactly two aisles, each at least 6 feet wide. Mr. Bennett received the updated certificate after a facilities inspection this week, but the revised capacity sheet has not yet been circulated with the event packet.

acceptance_conditions: The auditorium must be selected because the planned production requires its fixed fly system.
Exactly four lighting circuits must be reserved.
The audience capacity must be exactly 180 people.
The seating plan must include exactly two aisles that are each at least 6 feet wide.
A staging-and-lighting confirmation commitment must be recorded.
A fire-safety layout commitment must be recorded.
The production requirement must be cited by the principal after the theater teacher states it.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'staging_lighting_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'auditorium' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'fire_safety_layout' and c['target'] == 'auditorium' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The production's fixed-fly-system requirement changes the venue from the available generic event spaces to the auditorium and sets the lighting requirement at exactly four circuits.
The updated fire-safety certificate changes the allowable audience from the auditorium's listed 300-person capacity to exactly 180 and changes the layout to exactly two aisles at least 6 feet wide.
